name: SYD1 East (ex-Global Switch Sydney East) Stages 2 and 3

address.value: 273 Pyrmont Street, Ultimo NSW 2007 (East building of the 390-422 Harris Street campus)
address.note: Baxtel gives 273 Pyrmont St for SYD1 East; SSD-69637456 EIS describes SYD1E as the eastern building fronting Pyrmont Street (source 6)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '273 PYRMONT STREET ULTIMO' via NSW Spatial Services Geocoded Addressing Theme (address point type 1); address point, not building centroid

builder.note: Hutchies project page: Stages 2 and 3 of Sydney East, 88 weeks, completed 2017. Stage 1 (completed Sep 2014) was built by Icon (source 8). Kane Constructions later did a A$19m 33kV/UPS module upgrade (not dated; not this phase).

developer.note: developed by Global Switch; campus sold to HMC Capital / DigiCo in 2024

mw_it.note: Stage 2/3 IT MW not found. Icon (source 8) gives a 'total I.T. electrical load of 21.375MW' for the six-storey East building ('delivered over three separate stages'); Stage 1 share unknown. Stages 2-3 added 18,894 m2 of the East building's 31,226 m2 (source 1). Campus total 83 MVA utility (source 2).

mw_grid.note: 83 MVA utility power is for the whole East+West campus (source 2)

cost_aud_m.note: Hutchinson Builders project value $150M for Stages 2-3. Global Switch release (Mar 2016) calls the whole Sydney East development A$300m (source 3); datacenternews.asia reports US$300m (source 2).

authority.note: EIS history table: SYD1E approved as MP08_0222 on 16 Nov 2010; determining body inferred from the Part 3A MP reference, not stated in the EIS extract

pathway.note: MP08_0222; Mod-2 (1 Dec 2010) introduced staged construction; Mod-3 (15 Mar 2012) changed staging from two to three stages; Mod-7 (18 Apr 2017) construction hours

reference.note: 'A new wing, known as Global Switch Sydney 2 comprising a 6-storey commercial building with three basement levels'

determined.note: original approval for the whole East building, not specific to stages 2-3

construction_start.note: Global Switch release dated 29 Feb / 1 Mar 2016 announcing it had commenced construction of the final stages

construction_end.note: Hutchies: completed 2017 (88-week build). Stage 2 was due Q2 2017 for pre-commitment customers (sources 2, 3). EIS structural section: East building 'constructed in two stages (2014, 2017)'. Conflict: EIS heritage section says 'the northern portion was developed first and completed in 2017, whilst the remaining portion of the building was completed in 2020' (source 6).

open_questions: IT MW for stages 2-3 not found (East building total 21.375 MW IT per Icon; stages 2-3 = 18,894 of 31,226 m2)
completion: Hutchies says 2017; EIS heritage section says remaining portion completed 2020
planning determining authority inferred from Part 3A reference MP08_0222
